scope: 48 rewritten declarative XUI entrypoints and eight retained examples, matched Native/SDK ownership corrections and actual production compilers.

builds.windowsCore: Two resource objects rebuilt over exact Root11 production objects; algorithms unchanged.
builds.linuxCore: Both earlier frozen production profiles fully recompiled with original O2 flags, 2835 translation units; only resource catalogs changed.
builds.native: Fresh matched hosts/static profiles with additive copied-column APIs; Windows host resumed its validated own cache after one OOM. Compiler-support artifacts unchanged.

limits: Real bounded Windows graphics, 47-scene switching and one synthetic button-click assertion; not exhaustive manual UI or performance testing.
Linux has no display: CPU execution and AOT builds only.
Array projections use O(n) temporary storage; table columns copy text into one owned native allocation. Checked lifetime/error costs remain.
No network/security, browser, shell or OS clipboard tests.
Unrelated live compiler/IDE/native edits and historical flat-release deletions are excluded.
